jobs.occupation: Customs & Trade Manager Luxury (all genders) (Leiter/in - Export)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

Our Corporate Customs & Trade department is responsible for ensuring compliant and efficient cross-border trade activities across Beiersdorf globally. To strengthen our support for the Luxury business, we are looking for a Customs & Trade Manager Luxury who will act as the key business partner for our Luxury brands LaPrairie and Chantecaille and drive the integration of customs and trade processes into our global operating model.

Your main responsibilities will include:

- Act as the dedicated Customs & Trade business partner for our Luxury brands and support international business activities, cross-border trade activities and strategic business initiatives from a customs and trade compliance perspective.
- Ensure compliance with applicable international, European and national customs, export control and trade regulations, including sanctions and embargo requirements.
- Assess new business models, supply chain structures, distribution channels and strategic initiatives with regard to customs and trade implications, risks and opportunities.
- Drive the implementation, harmonization and continuous improvement of customs and trade processes, controls and governance standards across the Luxury business in alignment with global Beiersdorf requirements.
- Support the integration of Luxury entities, systems and operating models into Beiersdorf's global Customs & Trade framework.
- Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Tax, Legal and Commercial teams to ensure compliant and efficient trade flows.
- Define and implement customs and trade requirements within business processes, IT systems and master data structures, including SAP GTS
Monitor regulatory developments and translate legal requirements into practical and business-oriented solutions.
- Deliver training and advisory support to internal stakeholders and promote customs and trade awareness across the organization.
Manage and support customs and trade-related projects at global and regional level.

Your Profile

- University degree in Customs, International Trade, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law or a related field.
- Several years of professional experience in customs, international trade, export control or global trade compliance, gained in an international corporate, consulting or public sector environment.
- Strong understanding of customs regulations, international trade requirements/compliance and supply chain processes, ideally with exposure to luxury, consumer goods or FMCG businesses.
- Experience in process harmonization, transformation projects and cross-functional project management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a pragmatic and business-oriented mindset.
- Ability to work independently and manage complex topics in an international environment.
- Experience with SAP and ideally SAP GTS.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Fluent English required; German is considered an advantage.

At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.

Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We also embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.

Additional information

If you have any questions, please check our application FAQ first. If your question is not answered there, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition team via rc@beiersdorf.com (rc@beiersdorf.com) .

jobs.occupation: Head of Platform Architecture (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role

You will shape the technical foundation that makes enterprise-grade digital platforms and data products trusted, scalable, and ready for customers. In this pivotal role, you will own the end-to-end platform architecture across a portfolio of cloud-native products and deployment models — translating ambiguous business and customer needs into clear technical strategy, reusable capabilities, and executable roadmaps. You will define architectural principles covering security, scalability, resilience, and maintainability, and design data and AI platforms that span ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics, lineage, access control, and secure multi-tenancy. You will lead decisions on deployment strategies — including multi-cloud, hybrid, and customer-managed models — balancing data residency, cost, portability, and compliance. Applying security-by-design and defense-in-depth, you will ensure platforms are certifiable and audit-ready, translating frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, and GxP into concrete architectural controls. You will stay close to implementation — reviewing designs, prototypes, and critical code paths, establishing practices for infrastructure-as-code, continuous delivery, observability, and production operations, and helping teams move confidently from prototype to production. Beyond the technical work, you will lead, develop, and grow the platform architecture team: hiring, onboarding, coaching, managing performance, planning succession, and raising the technical bar across all levels. You will communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and constraints clearly to engineers, product leaders, customers, partners, auditors, and senior stakeholders — making complexity accessible without losing precision.

Who You Are

- You bring significant experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, data, or AI platforms and customer-facing digital products, with a proven ability to translate complex customer problems into architectures and executable roadmaps.
- You have deep, hands-on expertise in cloud-native architecture on at least one major provider (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) — including containers and Kubernetes, serverless, networking, identity and access management, and observability — alongside practical working knowledge of at least one additional provider.
- You have substantial experience owning secure architecture decisions in production environments, with working knowledge of relevant frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, and, where applicable, HIPAA or GxP/GAMP 5, including designing platforms that are certifiable and audit-ready.
- You have experience designing secure multi-tenant platforms and data architectures covering ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics, lineage, access controls, tenant-aware governance, and data quality, across multi-cloud, hybrid-cloud, or customer-managed deployment models.
- You have several years of direct experience managing and developing technical teams — including hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, career development, succession planning, and resource planning — and the credibility to challenge and mentor senior and principal engineers while remaining accountable for technical quality and delivery outcomes.
- You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related discipline, or bring equivalent practical experience, combined with typically 10 or more years in software engineering, cloud architecture, data-platform engineering, or related technical disciplines, including at least 7 years delivering production-grade, enterprise-scale platforms.
- You are proficient enough in modern programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or Go to review designs and critical code paths and guide implementation teams, and you have experience building commercial software products, SaaS platforms, or customer-managed deployments.
- You communicate fluently in English and can explain architectural decisions, limitations, costs, and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product leaders, customers, partners, auditors, and executives.

Location: Location-independent, hybrid flexibility.

Role evaluation:

Role department:

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role

As a Principal Scientist in the Structural Biology and Biophysics team, R&D Discovery, you will provide scientific leadership in interdisciplinary projects to elucidate structural mode of action and enable structure-based design with a focus on macromolecular complexes of antibodies, multispecifics and molecular degraders. You will strengthen our X-ray crystallography capabilities and, where possible complement our cryo-EM workflows to establish integrated, end-to-end experimental strategies for structural enablement — spanning protein and sample generation, data acquisition, and structural model building. You coordinate CRO/collaboration partner activities for reagents and data generation and drive innovations in structural biology. You clearly explain and communicate scientific findings and proposals to cross-functional teams and stakeholders to support informed and fast decision-making. You will mentor and develop junior scientists in structure biology and drug discovery contributing to a high-performing, collaborative culture.

- PhD in Structural Biology or a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience (including biopharma, biotech) and strong track record to design, execute and drive complex structural biology projects.

jobs.description:
TU Darmstadt stands for excellent and relevant science. We are playing a decisive role in shaping far-reaching processes of global change-from energy transition to artificial intelligence-through outstanding scientific knowledge and innovative academic programmes. We group our cutting-edge research into three fields: Energy and Environment, Information and Intelligence, Matter and Materials. We are a university with strong ties to the Frankfurt Rhine-Main metropolitan region and a very strong international focus. We are committed to European values and European integration.

The Centre for Synthetic Biology at TU Darmstadt is a university-wide interdisciplinary research initiative bringing together biologists and biochemists with computational scientists and machine learning researchers. The PhD candidate will conduct research in AI method development for the design of novel RNA molecules with application in advanced therapeutic modalities.
Work on an interdisciplinary topic at the intersection of machine learning / AI and synthetic biology
Learn the mathematics and algorithms of state-of-the-art RNA language models
Learn the mathematics and algorithms of state-of-the-art diffusion models for generation of new RNA and protein molecules
Advance AI methods and models for the design of novel RNA molecules that get conditionally activated upon binding of specific diagnostic RNA molecules
Find novel ways to Incorporate structure and sequence information in RNA AI-models.
Build novel AI models for quantitative functional prediction of RNA designs
Work in close collaboration with experimentalists that conduct high-throughput assays for the characterization of these novel RNA molecules

An excellent university science degree (Master’s/Diploma) in computer science, electrical engineering, physics or mathematics. Master’s/Diploma degree must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Very good programming skills in python; finished larger scientific software projects
Advanced academic training / background in machine learning and AI methods.
Experience with dedicated AI methods for molecular design is a big plus.
Solid understanding of molecular biology and cell biology is a big plus.
Willingness and drive to work on an interdisciplinary project beyond traditional boundaries.

In addition, you bring:

Fluency in English for communication in an international team and for writing scientific publications

On a personal level, you distinguish yourself through:

Analytical thinking and a high degree of self-organization
Curiosity and creativity
Openness to working in an interdisciplinary and international team

Your application should include:

a cover letter explaining succinctly why you want to join this project
your CV
bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and transcript of records
a list of publications / talks / poster contributions
contact details of 2 referees
Technical University of Darmstadt offers varied and challenging assignments, freedom to work independently, the latest technologies, good collaboration between colleagues in partnership, needs-based training opportunities and customised personnel development.

The fulfillment of the duties likewise enables the scientific qualifications of the candidate.

Development and organisation - comprehensive in-house training offers, including the opportunity for continuing education and development;
